title: Song Pal - Sing It Back
style: big band jazz, authentic jazz, international jazz, brass section stabs, muted trumpet harmonies, saxophone ensemble riffs, walking bass line, brushed snare swing, upright piano comping, jazz guitar chord chops, live drum kit, punchy kick, call and response vocals, spoken intro, singalong chant hook, 124 BPM, swung eighth feel, bright horn mix, room reverb, modern soul, female vocals, maracas, transcendent, rap-rock
lyrics:
Song Pal - Sing It Back
[Intro - soft, building]
Keep your book... we got a song book now
A song pal... no comments, just the song
Sing along with me...
[Chorus - big, repetitive, sing along energy]
No comments! No dislikes! No dislikes! No dislikes! - YEAH!
No comments! No dislikes! No dislikes! No dislikes! - YEAH!
That's what I like! YEAH that's what I like!
Sing it with me! Sing it back like a pen pal!
We sing it back! We sing it back!
No dislikes! No dislikes! No dislikes! - YEAH!
[Verse 1]
Duh, that was so last week, you speak book
Memory talk was last week, now we got the hook
Song book open, pages full of melody
Song pal by your side, singing steadily
Like a pen pal sending tracks across the wire
No comments in between, just the positive fire
Sing along, don't hold back, join the crew
Song pal got the vibe, it's all for you
[Pre-Chorus]
Keep your book on the shelf, this is our new way
Song book in the heart, every single day
[Chorus - bigger]
No comments! No dislikes! No dislikes! No dislikes! - YEAH!
No comments! No dislikes! No dislikes! No dislikes! - YEAH!
That's what I like! Sing it with me!
Like a pen pal we sing it back...
We sing it back! We sing it back!
[Verse 2]
Song book open, pages full of melody
Song pal by your side, singing steadily
Like a pen pal sending tracks across the wire
No comments in between, just the positive fire
Sing along, don't hold back, join the crew
Song pal got the vibe, it's all for you
[Bridge - call and response, sing along]
You: No dislikes...
Me: No dislikes!
You: Sing it with me...
Me: Im Singing it back!
All: YEAH! That's what I like!
[Final Chorus - loudest, everyone]
No comments, No dislikes, No dislikes, No dislikes - YEAH!
No comments, No dislikes, No dislikes, No dislikes - YEAH!
No comments, No dislikes, No dislikes, No dislikes - YEAH!
That's what I like! Sing it with me!
Like a pen pal we sing it back...
Song pal... song book... forever...
[Outro - fading together]
Just song... sing along... no comments...
No dislikes... YEAH...
We got a song book now...
Singing it back... sing it back...
